proposal.reason: Main change is moving NET/CollNet from process-global state to per-communicator backend selection and updating proxy progress/batching/shutdown behavior in transport/proxy paths (network). Communicator allocation/init/free now owns netName config, plugin retain/finalize, split-share backend compatibility, and per-comm U2MM modes (communicator). Bootstrap OOB device selection/listen now binds to each communicator’s selected NET backend instead of global NET state (bootstrap). Topology discovery/path logic and graph comparison now use comm-specific NET/EIC/PXN state via useEic and ncclPxnDisable(comm), affecting NIC width handling and PXN decisions (device-topology, graph-search).
